name: zycode
description: Chat with the zycode coding agent in VS Code. Unofficial; not affiliated with pi, Microsoft, or any model vendor.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: zycode runs an agent that reads and writes files and runs commands in your folder.

virtualWorkspaces.description: zycode runs a program on the machine that holds your folder. A virtual workspace has no such folder.

commands.title: Set up model and API key

zycode.agentPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path of a program (or a program name found on `PATH`) to run instead of the `zycode-agent` binary in this extension. Leave empty to use the bundled binary.

zycode.agentArgs.markdownDescription: Arguments for `#zycode.agentPath#`. For a Python install: path `python`, arguments `["-m", "pi_agent_cli"]`.

enumDescriptions: Ask before every action that is not read-only.
Run actions that are clearly in scope. Ask about the rest. Auto is not a sandbox: it guards what a call writes or runs, not what it reads or sends.
zycode.permissionMode.markdownDescription: The mode of a start: which tool calls the agent runs without asking. The extension sets it for each session through the `mode` option of the agent. It overrides `permission` in `agent.toml`, including `always-approve`. This setting offers `ask` and `auto` only: **Always approve** is chosen in the mode menu of the chat, after a warning, and it is never restored for a new chat or after a restart. An agent without a `mode` option keeps the mode of `agent.toml`. `auto` can send your messages and some `bash` commands to a model (see the README).

zycode.showThinking.description: Show the thinking blocks of the model in the chat (expanded while thinking, collapsed when done).

zycode.userAvatar.markdownDescription:
Custom avatar for your messages (`You`). Accepts a local image file path (supports `~/`), an `https://` image URL, or a `data:image/...` URI. Leave empty to use the built-in user icon, or the account picture that `#zycode.accountAvatar#` turns on. A file path is valid on one machine only, so this setting is per machine and is not synced.

[Choose local image…](command:zycode.chooseUserAvatar) · [Use account picture…](command:zycode.chooseAccountAvatar) · [Reset to default](command:zycode.resetUserAvatar)

enumDescriptions: Show the built-in user icon. zycode makes no request for an account picture.
Show the picture of your GitHub account. zycode sends your GitHub sign-in token to api.github.com.
Show the photo of your Microsoft account. zycode sends your Microsoft sign-in token to graph.microsoft.com.
zycode.accountAvatar.markdownDescription: The account whose picture zycode shows as your avatar (`You`). It is off until you choose an account with [Use account picture…](command:zycode.chooseAccountAvatar): VS Code then asks you to sign in, or to allow zycode to use the account. Setting a value here by hand does not ask: with no permission from VS Code, zycode shows the built-in icon and writes a hint to its log. An image of your own (`#zycode.userAvatar#`) wins over this picture. This setting is per machine, like the permission that VS Code keeps for the account.

zycode.autoModelAvatar.markdownDescription: Automatically switch the `zycode` avatar to match the active chat model (Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenAI/GPT, Claude, Grok, Kimi, Qwen). When off (or if the model does not match a built-in mascot), uses `#zycode.assistantAvatar#` or `#zycode.assistantAvatarPreset#`.

enumDescriptions: Copper-orange hair, gold-rimmed glasses & orange daisy
Starlight sapphire-lavender hair & four-pointed star hairpin
Blue-haired chibi maid with whale ear fins
White-haired dragon girl with horns & knot ornaments
Blonde twin-tails, dark gothic dress & golden X emblem
Periwinkle-haired beret girl in indigo-white hanfu
zycode.assistantAvatarPreset.markdownDescription: Built-in mascot avatar for `zycode`. Used when `#zycode.autoModelAvatar#` is off (or as fallback for unrecognized models), unless a custom `#zycode.assistantAvatar#` is set.

zycode.assistantAvatar.markdownDescription:
Custom avatar for `zycode` messages. Accepts a local image file path (supports `~/`), an `https://` image URL, or a `data:image/...` URI. Overrides `#zycode.assistantAvatarPreset#` when `#zycode.autoModelAvatar#` is off (or as fallback for unrecognized models). Leave empty to use the selected built-in mascot. A file path is valid on one machine only, so this setting is per machine and is not synced.

[Choose local image…](command:zycode.chooseAssistantAvatar) · [Choose built-in mascot…](command:zycode.chooseAssistantPreset) · [Reset to default](command:zycode.resetAssistantAvatar)

zycode.mcpServers.markdownDescription: MCP servers forwarded to the agent in `session/new` and `session/load`. Each entry is either a stdio server (`{ "name": "...", "command": "...", "args": [], "env": [{ "name": "...", "value": "..." }] }`) or an HTTP/SSE server (`{ "type": "http" | "sse", "name": "...", "url": "...", "headers": [{ "name": "...", "value": "..." }] }`). Application-scoped so workspace settings cannot inject executables.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with zycode
walkthroughs.description: Open a folder, save a model and a key, and say hello. You can open this guide again at any time.

steps.title: Open a folder
steps.description:
zycode works in the folder that is open in VS Code. Open a folder that you trust.
[Open folder](command:workbench.action.files.openFolder)

steps.title: Choose a model and save your key
steps.description:
The setup asks for a provider, a model id and an API key in a terminal. The key stays in the agent's own folder.
[Run setup](command:zycode.runSetup)

steps.title: Say hello
steps.description:
Write a message in the zycode view.
[Open chat](command:zycode.openChat)

steps.title: Choose how much zycode asks
steps.description:
Ask, Auto or Always approve. A new chat starts in Ask or Auto.
[Open the setting](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22zycode.permissionMode%22%5D)

steps.title: Find your past chats
steps.description:
The Past chats list shows the chats of this folder. Select one to open it.
[Show past chats](command:zycode.sessions.focus)

steps.title: If something does not work
steps.description:
A key that is not accepted, a wrong model id, a server that cannot be reached.
[Open agent.toml](command:zycode.openAgentConfig)
[Show log](command:zycode.showLog)
